cases.title: Totes for the tech crowd
cases.goal: Find 300 cotton tote bags with a one-colour club logo for our technology event. Compare vendors, collect quotes and negotiate within RM1,500. Deliver to Subang Jaya on or before 25 October.

vendors.name: Campus Printworks
vendors.description: Local printing studio with a fast turnaround and a hands-on production team.

vendors.name: Meridian Merchandise
vendors.description: Promotional merchandise supplier offering competitive base pricing.

vendors.name: Willow Supply Studio
vendors.description: Small-batch merchandise studio specialising in thoughtful, practical event goods.

events.title: Your brief, understood
events.detail: 300 cotton tote bags. RM1,500 ceiling. Arrive by 25 October.

events.title: Three suppliers compared
events.detail: Printing, landed cost and delivery checked against your brief.

events.title: Campus reached its price floor
events.detail: RM1,550 final offer. Above budget, so outreach moved to a backup.

events.title: A better offer from Willow
events.detail: RM1,800 → RM1,450, with the same quantity and printing.

events.title: Ready for your judgement
events.detail: Offers collected. The final choice belongs to your team.

draft.recipient: Willow Supply Studio · controlled demo recipient
draft.subject: Artwork proof for 300 custom tote bags
draft.body:
Hi Willow team,

Thank you for the revised all-in quotation of RM1,450 for 300 cotton tote bags with one-colour printing, delivered to Subang Jaya by 23 October.

Could you share a digital artwork proof and confirm the production timeline after we review it? This is an enquiry only; our organising team will make the final vendor decision.

Thank you,
Aina
Technology Club

cases.title: A little fuel for big ideas
cases.goal: Find a catering partner for a 50-person student workshop. Vegetarian options required. We need comparable quotes before making a decision.
